summary: Blue Ridge granite scrambles, Appalachian Trail ridge walks, and cascading hollow waterfalls.

trails.name: Old Rag Mountain Rock Scramble Circuit
trails.condition_note: 1-mile granite boulder scramble near summit; day-use ticket required.
trails.description: Virginia's most famous hike: ascends the thrilling 360-degree granite boulder scramble to Old Rag summit (3,284 ft) and loops back via Saddle and Weakley Hollow Fire Road.

trails.name: Hawksbill Summit Loop via Salamander & AT
trails.condition_note: Highest peak in Shenandoah NP; Byrd Nest shelter at summit.
trails.description: Climbs through high-elevation balsam fir forest along the Appalachian Trail and Salamander Trail to the 4,050-ft rocky summit of Hawksbill.
